topic: Properties, Changes, and Mixtures of Materials
key_concepts: Solids have definite shape and volume.
Liquids have no definite shape but have definite volume.
Gases have no definite shape and no definite volume.
Porous materials absorb water because they have spaces inside where liquid can be absorbed
Non-porous materials like plastic and glass do not allow water to pass through easily.
Biodegradable materials decay with the help of sunlight, soil, and water.
Non-biodegradable materials such as plastics should be recycled or disposed of properly.
